t: Purchase Intent Assessment and Smart Sales Reply Generator

A browser-based tool that sorts posts by newest, assesses purchase intent using multiple factors, and generates sales reply drafts with flagged prohibited phrases, requiring human approval before copying.
Assess purchase intent and generate personalized sales reply drafts

This app lets you manage imported posts and assess purchase intent easily, offline. Paste a list of posts with their dates, and the app will sort them by recency and provide assessment indicators including recommendation requests, comparisons, budget, and decision timing. Based on these indicators, it generates a sales reply draft based on the templates and facts you enter, highlighting prohibited phrases for editing before copying. The copy button is only enabled after your explicit confirmation, ensuring full human control over publishing. Enjoy a fast and secure experience within the current website page.
